breadth_worlds.status: pre-registered here before any breadth world was generated (experiments/worlds_007.py does not exist at this commit)
breadth_worlds.world: HiddenWorldK(n,k,s,transitions,emissions,start,seed,family): k actions 0..k-1, s binary sensors, m=2**s codes; transitions[q] is a tuple of k successors; emissions[q] in 0..m-1; bits of code c are ((c>>(s-1-j))&1 for j in 0..s-1) (big-endian, same as bgr89 for s=2); observed(h,rate,step): rng=random.Random((seed*1299709+step*23011+701)%2**64); each bit in order is shown iff rng.random()>=rate else None (identical to bgr89 HiddenWorld.observed for s=2); the initial observation uses step=-1, the observation after step i (0-based) uses step=i
breadth_worlds.mask: mask(obs) = set of codes c with every shown bit j equal to bit j of c (bitmask over m codes)
breadth_worlds.passive_actions: rng=random.Random(seed*72031+37); tuple(rng.randrange(k) for _ in range(steps)) (equals bgr89.worlds.actions for k=2)
breadth_worlds.reachable: _reach(rng,n,k): repeat up to 10000 times: T=[[rng.randrange(n) for a in range(k)] for q in range(n)] (row-major), start=rng.randrange(n); accept iff every state is reachable from start; else ValueError

generators.big6: rng=random.Random(seed*130363+307); n=6,k=2,s=2; T,start=_reach(rng,6,2); codes=rng.sample(range(4),3); em=[c0,c0,c1,c1,c2,c2]; rng.shuffle(em)
generators.sens3: rng=random.Random(seed*130363+311); n=4,k=2,s=3; T,start=_reach(rng,4,2); codes=rng.sample(range(8),3); em=[c0,c0,c1,c2]; rng.shuffle(em)
generators.act3: rng=random.Random(seed*130363+313); n=4,k=3,s=2; T,start=_reach(rng,4,3); codes=rng.sample(range(4),3); em=[c0,c0,c1,c2]; rng.shuffle(em)
generators.ood6s3: rng=random.Random(seed*130363+317); n=6,k=2,s=3; T,start=_reach(rng,6,2); codes=rng.sample(range(8),4); em=[c0,c0,c1,c1,c2,c3]; rng.shuffle(em)

backend.name: brute/region.py RegionK: ConstraintRegion generalised to k actions and m codes (new file; brute/geometry.py stays frozen)
backend.encoding: identical to BRUTE_PLAN_006 representation (one-hot x[t][q], d[q][a][r], e[q][c]; canonical first-visit naming; derived A, V, Tr, nx, nc) with range(2) -> range(k) for actions and range(4) -> range(m) for codes; Glucose3 (python-sat); rebuilt per step, one solver per region answers all queries of that step through assumptions
backend.queries: feasible, support(b), saturated(), y1k(b,mask) (= BRUTE_PLAN_006 fibre_support with one mask), extended(a,c)
backend.tri_state: every solve returns SAT, UNSAT or UNKNOWN (budget hit). Conservative semantics: UNKNOWN on a support/Y1k code query counts the code as possible; UNKNOWN on saturation counts as saturated; UNKNOWN on feasibility after an observation sets status 'budget_exhausted' (sticky, as enumeration budget exhaustion is). Every forecast records solver_unknown = number of UNKNOWN answers used to build it.
backend.abstain_rule: SOLVER_BUDGET overlay: if a forecast used >=1 UNKNOWN answer and its status would otherwise be CERTIFIED, POSSIBLE_SET or ABSTAIN (any reason), it becomes ABSTAIN / SOLVER_BUDGET with certificate None (new reason value SOLVER_BUDGET). Feasibility UNKNOWN gives ABSTAIN / BUDGET_EXHAUSTED via the frozen gate order. In a lookahead branch any UNKNOWN makes that branch count 0 (counted in lookahead_budget_hits).
backend.production_meaning: A5/M5 (2x2) and B5/BM5/BP5 (breadth) never enumerate rows: every version-space query (family, margin, window tier, lookahead copies) goes through RegionK. Enumeration runs only in the A4 reference arm and in the second implementation.

arms.A5: brute.region_learner.RegionBruteLearner: the A4 rules (v0.1.1 probabilities, v0.2.0 window tier, Y1k, LU-R, tau6 alarm + resume) with every version-space query on RegionK (family <=4, margin <=5, window <=4); production backend arm
arms.M5: A5 certification with the M policy (projection-volume tie-break, below) instead of plain LU-R
arms.A4: frozen brute.resume.ResumeBruteLearner (enumeration, v0.4.0), run through the frozen study-006 trajectory code as a full arm; exactness reference for GX1 and v0.90 control for G3-prime
arms.A2: frozen brute.active.ActiveBruteLearner (v0.2.0, tau 1.4331), slim trace; G6b baseline
arms.B5: brute.breadth.BreadthBruteLearner on breadth worlds, RegionK backend, LU-R generalised to k actions, tau7 alarm + resume
arms.BP5: B5 on the passive action sequence (also the tau7 calibration arm with the alarm disabled)

gate_order: margin budget_exhausted or not supported -> ABSTAIN/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (contradicted margin: ABSTAIN/MARGIN_DISAGREES)
Y1k(b, mask of latest observation) != S_f(b) -> ABSTAIN/RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS
else CERTIFIED; then the SOLVER_BUDGET overlay
breadth_learner.public: public certificate iff certified, attested for the declared family, and no alarm ever set in the session (never re-attested after a resume)
breadth_learner.probabilities: p(c) = (1-eps)*uniform over S_f(b) + eps/m when the family is supported [source family]; else (1-eps)*uniform over S_m(b) + eps/m when the margin is supported with nonempty support [source margin]; else 1/m [source uniform]; eps=0.02; S_f, S_m are the conservative supports
breadth_learner.surprise: -ln(sum of p(c) over codes c compatible with the observation); residual = mean of the last W=8 surprises rounded to 12 d.p.
breadth_learner.alarm: alarm set when residual > tau7; resume exactly as BRUTE_PLAN_006 alarm_rule.resume (W=8 consecutive residuals <= tau7 with family and margin supported)
breadth_learner.tau7_calibration: run BP5 with the alarm disabled (tau=+inf) on every calibration_ranges_tau7 case x 3 mask rates (450 cases, 64 passive steps); tau7 = maximum residual_after over every step of every calibration case, rounded to 12 d.p.; per-family maxima recorded. One tau7 for all breadth families.
breadth_learner.retraction: issued certificates are retracted at family contradiction (as v0.1.1); issued = predicted and acted (taken action)

experiment_rules.LU-R_k: score(a) = round(mean over c in S_f(a) of N(a,c), 12); N(a,c)=0 if the family copy after (a, full code c) is infeasible, has an UNKNOWN, or is saturated; singles = {b : S_f'(b) = {s} and Y1k_f'(b,{c}) = {s}}; 0 if no singles or the margin copy is infeasible/UNKNOWN; else #{b in singles : S_m'(b) = {s}}. All scores 0 when family or margin is not supported or the alarm is on. Choice: argmax; if the default (passive) action is among the maximisers take it, else the lowest-index maximiser. For k=2 this is exactly the v0.3.0 LU-R.
experiment_rules.M (new: projection-volume tie-break): among the LU-R maximisers, take the action with the smallest fibre volume V(a) = round(mean over c in S_f(a) of sum over b of log2 |Y1k_f'(b,{c})|, 12), f' = family copy after (a, full code c); a branch with an infeasible copy or an UNKNOWN contributes k*log2(m); remaining ties -> default action if among them, else lowest index. V is computed only when >=2 actions tie on the LU-R score and family and margin are supported with no alarm. Geometric reading (Inferred): when no action makes a certificate likely, cut the region so that the projection of the latest-observation fibre on the next-code coordinates is smallest, i.e. localise the current state, the step Y1k needs and plain LU-R ignores on ties.
experiment_rules.not_built: exact or approximate #SAT model counting of the region is NOT built in v0.5.0 (no counter in the pinned environment; an approximate count cannot be exactness-gated): Open

metrics: 2x2: identical to BRUTE_PLAN_006 metrics (dual coverage = both actions, on-policy coverage, false/stale certificates, drift steps 12/23/34). Breadth: all-action coverage = certificates over (post-burn-in step x k actions); false certificates over every step and every action; same status breakdown.

scoring.soundness_counts: all steps incl. burn-in, every action (taken and counterfactual)
scoring.loss: -ln max(1e-12, p[actual]) on the full code
scoring.bootstrap: seed-clustered paired bootstrap (each seed = its 3 mask cases), 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261025), percentile 2.5/97.5

GX1_backend_exactness_2x2.threshold: A5 vs A4 on every 2x2 case and step: identical action, experiment scores/tied/proposal, and for BOTH actions identical status, reason, certificate, public_certificate, support, margin_support, saturated, probabilities, forecast_source; identical surprise, residual_after, alarm_after, issued, retractions, alarm/resume steps. Count of mismatching steps must be 0. Excluded and counted (not mismatches): steps from the first step where A4 reports any enumeration budget event (family/margin/window budget_exhausted or a lookahead budget hit) and steps where A5 has solver_unknown>0. The gate also requires excluded steps <= 1% of all 2x2 steps.

GX2_backend_exactness_breadth.threshold: experiments/v050_reference.py (enumeration, no brute import) recomputes for B5, BM5 and BP5 on every breadth case every support, margin support, saturation, Y1k decision, status/reason/certificate, probability, surprise, residual, alarm/resume state, LU-R score, M volume and chosen action, step by step until its own row budget (160000) is exceeded. Mismatching steps must be 0. Steps after a reference budget exhaustion are excluded and counted; sens3, act3 and ood6s3 must each have >= 90% of their steps checked. big6 (<=6/<=7) is checked only as far as enumeration fits; its unchecked share is reported (that is the point of the backend).

GX3_budget_abstains.threshold: (a) stress block (conf_budget 20): >=1 forecast with solver_unknown>0 must occur (else GX3 is OPEN, not passed); every forecast with solver_unknown>0 has certificate None and status ABSTAIN (reason SOLVER_BUDGET or BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) or OUT_OF_FAMILY; 0 false certificates. (b) all production arms: 0 certificates with solver_unknown>0. (c) unit test with a forced UNKNOWN.

G1_in_family_soundness.threshold: A5, M5: 0 false conditional and 0 false public certificates on every in_family_2x2 case; B5, BM5, BP5: same on every in_family_breadth case; all steps incl. burn-in, every action

G2_ood_soundness.threshold: A5, M5: 0 false conditional certificates on ood5; B5, BM5, BP5: 0 false conditional certificates on ood6s3; all steps, every action
G2_ood_soundness.pre_registered_risk: Inferred: a 6-state 3-sensor world can make <=4 and <=5 agree on a wrong code before a contradiction; Y1k reduces but does not exclude this. No design data.

G3_prime_drift4.threshold: study-005 definition for A5 and M5 separately (taken action): non-drift false = 0 AND total <= 0.5 x v0.90 control false on the same cases (v0.90 control from the A4 full trace)

G4_public_safety.threshold: A5, M5, B5, BM5, BP5: 0 public certificates on ood5, drift4 and ood6s3; 0 wrong public certificates anywhere; no public certificate after the first alarm of a session

G5_false_alarm_limit.threshold: for EACH arm A5, M5, B5, BM5, BP5 and EACH in-family family of its block separately: fraction of cases with >=1 RESIDUAL_SURPRISE alarm <= 0.05

G6b_M_coverage_vs_v020.threshold: pooled in_family_original_2x2 dual coverage M5 - A2 >= -0.03 AND 95% CI lower bound >= -0.05 (the BRUTE_PLAN_006 G6b' test with M5 in place of A4)
G6b_M_coverage_vs_v020.prediction: Inferred: FAIL. M changes only which action is taken on LU-R ties; v0.4.0 measured A4 - A2 = -0.104, and the price is in the Y1k certification rule, which M does not change.

G7_open_world.threshold: mean post-burn-in taken-action log-loss: A5 and M5 <= ln 4 on ood5 and drift4; B5, BM5, BP5 <= ln 8 on ood6s3; min probability >= eps/m everywhere (0.005 for 2x2, 0.0025 for 8 codes)

G9_retraction_resume.threshold: every resume (A5, M5, B5, BM5, BP5) happens only after W=8 consecutive residuals <= tau with family and margin supported; no RESYNC_AMBIGUOUS forecast is issued; retractions only at contradiction

G10_compute.threshold: every case of every block completes; production arms: forecasts with solver_unknown>0 <= 1% of forecasts per block
G10_compute.reported: wall-clock per arm, A5 vs A4 time ratio, per-step max

G11_second_implementation.threshold: (a) experiments/v050_reference.py (same author, no brute import, committed before any v0.5.0 brute/ file) audits every A5, M5, B5, BM5, BP5 trace (2x2: the v0.4.0 reference rules with rows fields null and the M tie-break; breadth: its own generalised enumeration); (b) the frozen experiments/v040_reference.py audits every A4 trace. Report = COUNT of mismatching arm traces (no stop at first), must be 0; breadth traces are audited up to the reference row budget. Mutation test: 20 injected single-field errors in 20 distinct traces (random.Random(20261025)) detected 20/20 with 0 false flags.

G12_reproducibility.threshold: a second run of the calibration and of every case whose run index is divisible by 3 (2x2, breadth and stress blocks) to a new path gives byte-identical scientific JSON (timing keys stripped) for those cases and an identical CALIBRATION_007.json

G13_tau7_reproduces.threshold: tau7 and per-family maxima reproduce byte-for-byte in the second calibration run, and study-007 uses exactly that tau7

GM_projection_volume_mechanism.report: pooled in_family_2x2 dual coverage M5 - A5 with CI, per family and mask; tie frequency; how often M overrides the default; breadth all-action coverage BM5 - B5
GM_projection_volume_mechanism.decision_rule: SUPPORTED iff M5 - A5 CI lower > 0 and G1/G2/G3-prime hold for M5; HARMFUL iff CI upper < 0; else NOT DISTINGUISHED
GM_projection_volume_mechanism.prediction: Inferred: NOT DISTINGUISHED or small positive (<= +0.03); no design data

R_breadth.report: breadth all-action coverage B5, BM5, BP5 per family and mask; status breakdown; ood6s3 alarm detection rate and first-alarm step; minimal true state counts; A5 vs A4 wall-clock
